copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 把 Resend 邮件渠道接入项目：复制适配器、安装依赖、配置 API 密钥和收信 webhook，并把指定邮箱设为所有者、发送欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 用户要求用 Resend 添加邮件渠道时触发。

say.text: 给项目加一个 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 开始复制适配器、装依赖并注册。

say.text: 把 admin@example.com 设为所有者。
say.note: 会注册该邮箱为所有者并发一封欢迎信。

say.text: 配置 Resend 的 API 密钥和 webhook。
say.note: 会提示你粘贴密钥，然后写入配置。

howto.what_en: Connects the project to email via Resend: copies the adapter, installs the pinned package, configures API key and inbound webhook, wires the given email as owner, and sends a welcome email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add an email channel with Resend.

say_en.text: Add a Resend email channel to the project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dependency, and registers it.
Registers that email as owner and sends a welcome email.

say_en.text: Configure the Resend API key and webhook.
say_en.note: Prompts for the secrets and writes them to the config.
